summary: End-to-end test of new capabilities: (1) AI Insurance Import and (2) UK/IE regional terminology. Backend: added 8 new pytest cases across TestRegion (4) and TestInsurance/AI-import (3 new + existing 4). All 46 tests in the full suite pass (2 transient network-timeout flakes on preview URL passed cleanly on retry). AI Insurance Import backend contract verified via curl + pytest: POST /api/insurance/ai-import (multipart 'files') successfully extracted insurer/policy_type/expiry from a plaintext certificate in ~1.6s via Gemini 2.5 Flash (FileContentWithMimeType); returns {count, created:[{id,filename,policy_type,insurer,expiry_date,needs_review}]}. Region endpoint PUT /api/settings/region persists to Mongo, /auth/me returns region, 400 on invalid region, 401 without auth. Frontend Playwright: logged in as manager@haulcheck.co.uk, verified region-switcher renders in sidebar; UK Fleet Vehicles thead shows 'MOT', Trailers thead shows 'Annual Test', add-vehicle dialog label 'MOT Due', insurance cover placeholder uses £; switched to IE via region-IE button (toast 'Switched to Ireland (RSA)' shown), reloaded page and IE remained active (bg-white on IE button), Vehicles thead switched to 'CVRT' (no MOT), trailers thead 'CVRT' (no Annual Test), veh dialog label 'CVRT Due', insurance placeholder uses €. Reset to UK at end. AI Insurance Import UI flow: opened ai-import-button dialog, set_input_files on hidden ai-import-input with a plaintext PL certificate, clicked ai-import-run, results appeared under ai-import-results within ~2s ('Hiscox Ltd — Public Liability (PL) · exp 2027-12-31'), clicked ai-import-done to close, new insurance card visible in list with AI badge and PUBLIC LIABILITY (PL) policy_type label. Manual add/edit/delete flow works (add-insurance-button → ins-insurer/ins-number/ins-expiry/ins-cover → save-insurance-button; edit-insurance-button + delete-insurance-button). Dashboard now has a kpi-insurance card (iteration 6 gap resolved). Regression smoke: all sidebar nav items (nav-dashboard, nav-calendar, nav-inspections, nav-vehicles, nav-drivers, nav-training, nav-defects, nav-documents, nav-insurance) load; logout redirects to /login. All test data cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 372: /auth/register hard-codes region: 'UK' in returned user payload but /auth/login (line 337-ish) does not include region in the login response body — /auth/me is required to hydrate region on login. Frontend loginWithToken(token, userData) receives the login response minus region; the AuthContext initial region will therefore be undefined until /auth/me runs. This is acceptable because AuthContext calls checkAuth() on mount, but if login flow ever skips /me it will fall back to REGIONS.UK via getTerms default — non-blocking.

server.py PUT /api/settings/region (line 381-387) accepts a raw dict rather than a Pydantic model. Consider a `RegionSetting(BaseModel)` with a Literal['UK','IE'] for API-doc & validation clarity — currently the 400 is enforced manually.

server.py ai_extract_insurance (line 712-751) — good separation and correct model routing (OpenAI gpt-4o for images, Gemini 2.5 Flash for PDFs & other MIME). Text/plain files also go through Gemini path (falls into the else branch) — works but not documented in the frontend accept='image/*,application/pdf' attribute. If the intent is 'PDF/image only' the backend should reject other content_types with 400 for consistency; if 'be permissive', keep as-is.

server.py ai_import_insurance never returns partial-failure info — if put_object fails for one file it is silently skipped (line 767-769). Consider returning a `failed` array alongside `created` so the UI can inform the user which uploads didn't ingest.

server.py normalize_policy_type ordering (line 691-709): 'green card' check comes AFTER 'employ' and 'public' — order is fine. However the 'trailer' branch fires for 'Motor — Trailer' AND for any string containing 'trailer', which correctly overrides the later 'motor'/'truck' branch — good defensive ordering.

Frontend Insurance.js runAiImport (line 61-78): sets Content-Type: multipart/form-data explicitly, forcing axios to skip its automatic boundary — some axios versions handle this fine, others do not. Prefer to omit the header and let axios+FormData set it. Non-blocking; observed working here.

Frontend Insurance.js: after ai import runs, `load()` is called but the modal stays open showing results. Good UX. However cards created with needs_review=true render both an 'AI' AND 'Review' badge — visually correct.

Frontend delete-insurance-button (line 111) still deletes with a single click, no confirmation dialog. Regulated data — recommend an AlertDialog confirm. Consistent with vehicles/documents (pre-existing pattern).

server.py line 688 INSURANCE_TYPES uses em-dashes ('Motor — Truck'). Frontend TYPES const in Insurance.js also uses em-dashes. If any API client posts en-dash ('Motor – Truck') or hyphen ('Motor - Truck'), normalize_policy_type will still catch it via the 'motor'/'truck' fallback — resilient.
region-switcher: sidebar footer button lacks disabled/loading state during the PUT — a double-click could fire two updateRegion calls. Minor.

Terms library only exposes 6 keys (authority, vehicleTest, trailerTest, currency, operatorLicence, tagline). If future pages need date format or number format they'll need to be added. Not required for this PR.

success_rate.backend: 100% (46/46 tests; 2 transient network timeouts re-ran green)
success_rate.frontend: 100% for AI Import, region switcher, terminology UK/IE, insurance CRUD, smoke nav

seed_data_creation: During tests: created & deleted a plaintext insurance certificate through /api/insurance/ai-import (Hiscox Ltd PL). Manual UI add TEST_UI_MANUAL_Ins (edited then deleted). Also removed pre-existing TEST_* leftovers from previous pytest runs (TEST AXA EL, TEST Aviva GIT, TEST-Iso). Account region reset to UK at end. TestRegion pytest creates a TEST_region_* user (uuid suffix) for register-defaults check — not deleted (register does not expose delete). No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (46 tests, ~75s including AI import calls). Region-only: pytest .../backend_test.py::TestRegion (4 tests, <5s). AI import + insurance: pytest .../backend_test.py::TestInsurance (7 tests, ~10s). Note: test_insurance_isolation_between_users was accidentally left INSIDE class TestRegion during edit — it still discovers & passes (independent of region logic) but should be moved back under class TestInsurance in a future cleanup. AI import endpoint accepts text/plain (Gemini path) even though frontend restricts to image/*+pdf — useful for smoke tests. Region defaults to UK on register; PUT /api/settings/region {region:'UK'|'IE'} returns {ok,region}; /auth/me returns region.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All happy-path and edge cases (invalid region, no-auth, missing insurance id) behave correctly. AI extraction quality was very good on a plaintext certificate: correctly extracted insurer, policy_number, expiry_date, cover_amount and classified as Public Liability (PL) in <2s.
